title: src/definition/store.zig:1356 parseGraphJson leaks node IDs (pre-existing)
symptom: Every Definition with graph_json causes parseGraphJson to dupe node IDs without a matching free. Surfaced by tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig TC-ISS-601-01 (48 leaks) and TC-ISS-601-05 (42 leaks).
root_cause: parseGraphJson calls allocator.dupe(u8, n.id) for each node/edge field. The parent Definition struct holds slices but has no allocator-aware destructor; callers drop the Definition without freeing the duplicates. Affects every load site of a Definition with graph_json.
remediation_strategies: Add Definition.deinit(allocator) that frees all dupe'd strings; callers must invoke it.
Use an arena allocator owned by parent Definition so all allocations share the parent's lifetime.
Switch to allocator ownership transfer semantics at every load site (less invasive).
